Initial release of music-2.5 skill.

- Generate full-length songs with natural vocals from user-supplied lyrics and style prompts.
- Supports structure tags for flexible song arrangements (e.g., [Verse], [Chorus], [Solo]).
- Customizable output options: sample rate, bitrate, and audio format (MP3 default).
- Designed for use as source tracks in AI-driven music video workflows.
- Strong performance in English and Mandarin; outputs are unique per generation.
- Not for narration or instrumental-only needs—see related skills for those cases.
